Name: AutoEat Eidee Bridge
Author: dagarxji
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bridge mod to allow restarting autocast after autoeat.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Put directory containing AutoEatEideeBridge.dll into mod directory.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Bridges AutoEat and Eidee's Easy Fishing autocast.[/*]
[*]Trash deletion option, with a toggleable exception for Joja Cola.[/*]
[*]Separate item deletion option in case you want to delete things like bait.[/*]
[*]Mute function.[/*]
[*]Optional Fast Animations integration tied to progression, with 20 total animation speed levels: 10 from fishing level, 5 from reaching level 10 in each skill, and 5 from mastery levels. Fishing level 10 gives 2 levels since it counts for both fishing progression and a level 10 skill.[/*]
[*]Optional TimeSpeed integration that ties faster animation levels to game speed. This helps keep faster fishing from turning into hundreds of fish per day. I use 60% TimeSpeed sync strength and that seems like a decent mix to me.[/*]
[*]Tracker to see how many fish caught / day + rate, etc.[/*]
[*]Options can be adjusted using Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Eidee's Easy Fishing[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]AutoEat[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Optional Integrations[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Fast Animations
TimeSpeed[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://github.com/dagarxji/SDVMods/releases/tag/AutoEatEideeBridge-release/latest]Github Link[/url][/color]
[b]Development note:[/b] This mod was primarily developed using agentic AI coding tools. I direct the features, behavior, testing, and changes, but portions of the underlying code are AI-generated and may not have been manually reviewed line-by-line.

Manifest.Name: Auto-Eat + Eidee Easy Fishing Bridge
Manifest.Description: Resumes Eidee Auto Recast after Auto-Eat, tracks fishing stats, and syncs Fast Animations' fishing speed and TimeSpeed's flow of time with fishing/mastery level.
